notes_for_editor: Two register-level sources (the FFLOS entry and a regional list) plus one map-archive page. None gives a build date, staffing, fires, or current access. The 2008 removal is 'believed' on the register. The 1982 landmark is from Pastmaps, a map archive, so it shows the tower was on that sheet but is not a primary map image. The brief's record has no errors I could confirm. Access and visit details are unknown; the story says so.
